HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVINDER DUDEJA  ORDER % 08.07.2025 CRL.M.A. 13716/2025 (exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This application stands disposed of.

1. This is a petition under Section 528 BNSS, 2023 for quashing of FIR No. 0222/2022 under Sections 323/354/354B/509 IPC registered at Police Station Samaypur Badli, along with consequential proceedings arising out of the said FIR.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the respondents states that a similar petition between the same parties, for quashing of FIR No. 0307/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at Police Station Samaypur Badli, is listed before the coordinate Bench of Justice Girish Kathpalia.
